initial_findings: Confirmed-idle launch-pending cleanup could remain behind an unreusable uncertain permit.
Terminal registration and new child attachment publication were not atomically arbitrated.
Completed child-terminal aliasing lacked an explicit actor lease epoch comparison.
Several required regressions asserted source text without behavioral stop/request counters.
Projection guarding unintentionally disabled host-selection screensaver cache artwork.
corrections: Added provider_idle_confirmed and exact idle/running permit variants.
Added shared-lock terminal reservation before provider observation and before parent-close leaves the control lock.
Added actor lease epoch validation to both completed-receipt selection and final alias validation.
Added behavioral concurrency, immediate-start, zero-stop/disconnect/terminate, rejected-start and exact projection tests.
Added explicit-key screensaver cache/fetch paths with selected-profile checks before request and apply.
final_confirmation: The final in-progress check shares the Gateway state lock and immediately precedes attachment publication.
Confirmed-idle permit reuse requires empty process identity in the active operation, child session and retained stream.
A terminal reservation prevents a late heartbeat/process observation from binding a process to the retiring session.
No new identity loss, deadlock or retained terminal handoff was found.
limitations: Physical Windows/TV acceptance was outside this run and remains pending.
